attributes.name: skz-text
attributes.description: Element mark. Marks a text element: the text of its whole subtree becomes bars that follow the real text lines, drawn according to the root's skz-text-mode. Ignored on a skz-bone / skz-leaf / skz-ignore element itself and inside skz-leaf / skz-ignore.

attributes.name: skz-bone
attributes.description: Element mark. The element becomes one bone and its descendants get visibility: hidden; the real content of img / video / canvas is pushed out of the box. Radius defaults to --skz-radius, an element's own border-radius is kept.

attributes.name: skz-leaf
attributes.description: Element mark. Merges the whole subtree into one bone: descendants hidden, underlines in the subtree removed. Drawn like skz-bone except that media content is not handled (use skz-bone on img etc.).

attributes.name: skz-host
attributes.description: Element mark. Marks a Web Component host (Shadow DOM): the host gets visibility: hidden and its ::before paints one bone, with the same variables and animation as skz-bone.

attributes.name: skz-ignore
attributes.description: Element mark. Kept as-is, clickable and focusable; the enable() interaction lock skips branches that contain it. While the root contains one, the implicit default fade is off (an explicit effect: fade still runs).

attributes.name: skz-auto
attributes.description: Element mark. Marks an inference region (the root itself or any element inside it): bones are inferred from a tag allow-list (text tags, media and controls, empty <i> and empty elements whose class contains icon).

attributes.name: skz
attributes.description: Root attribute. Turns the skeleton on for this root: styles, theme variables and the interaction lock hang off it. Normally written by enable() / the adapters; hand-write it for plain HTML without JS.

attributes.name: skz-effect
attributes.description: Root attribute. The animation effect, matching the effect option. fade is the default when omitted.

attributes.name: skz-text-mode
attributes.description: Root attribute. How text bones are drawn, matching the text option. round is the default when omitted. lite only reads a hand-written round / clip; underline and leaf are full only.

attributes.name: skz-shimmer-mode
attributes.description: Root attribute. How the shimmer band sweeps, matching the shimmerMode option. even (default) moves all bones at the same speed; fit sweeps each bone inside its own box. Full only.

attributes.name: skz-cv
attributes.description: Root attribute. Gives the root's direct children content-visibility: auto, so children scrolled out of view skip style, layout and paint (--skz-cv-size is the height estimate, default 200px). Full only.
